preserve: Recursive text-token expansion, missing-text and cycle refusals
Deterministic fields, accumulated destinations, legacy block delimiters, text and JSON renderers
Nested say lists, from_json length limits, and reasons for required, optional, host and content-script permissions
allowed_deltas: Caller supplies source object, reader, sourceName and explicit allowed outputs; no product filesystem or source defaults
Return Map instead of an object; app wrapper may convert to its existing object interface
Block attribution says written from the supplied source name, without the old app-specific script command; legacy delimiters and replacement semantics remain
Source name closes over unchanged helpers so nested diagnostics retain caller attribution
Refuse any explicitly requested output absent from source.places so a missing required destination cannot silently pass a caller check; empty selection remains allowed.
banned_substitutions: Copying product-filled or private customer DATA into generic implementation
Counting archived baseline bytes as active retention
Claiming the current uncommitted app adapter has a fabricated source commit

lineage.source: Real committed original parser and renderer; current app adapter inherited the same helpers but was uncommitted when inspected.
lineage.privacy_and_rights: Explicitly authorized repository-owned generic code port. Full excerpt inspected: pure parsing/rendering functions, no credentials, customer records, filled listing DATA or third-party attribution notices. Original package was private and had no LICENSE file at the source ref; publication rests on the owner's explicit authorization, not an inferred public licence.

active_target.method: Trim lines and count source lines of at least 24 characters present in the active target line set. Baseline excluded.
